import zipfile, struct

def parse_dex_classes(dex_bytes):
    # DEX header: magic (8), checksum (4), signature (20), file_size (4), header_size (4), endian_tag (4),

    # class_defs_size (4), class_defs_off (4)
    if len(dex_bytes) < 112 or dex_bytes[:4] != b'dex\n':
        return []
    string_ids_size, string_ids_off = struct.unpack_from('<II', dex_bytes, 56)
    type_ids_size, type_ids_off = struct.unpack_from('<II', dex_bytes, 64)
    class_defs_size, class_defs_off = struct.unpack_from('<II', dex_bytes, 96)

    string_offsets = [struct.unpack_from('<I', dex_bytes, string_ids_off + i * 4)[0] for i in range(string_ids_size)]
    
    def get_string(idx):
        off = string_offsets[idx]
        # read uleb128 utf16_size
        pos = off
        val = 0
        shift = 0

            b = dex_bytes[pos]
            pos += 1
            val |= (b & 0x7f) << shift
            if not (b & 0x80):
                break
            shift += 7
        end = dex_bytes.find(b'\x00', pos)
        return dex_bytes[pos:end].decode('utf-8', errors='ignore')
    
    # Read type_ids -> string_idx
    type_string_indices = [struct.unpack_from('<I', dex_bytes, type_ids_off + i * 4)[0] for i in range(type_ids_size)]
